basics.name: Rohan Nuthi
basics.label: Computer Engineering & Computer Science student, software and embedded engineer
basics.summary: Co-founder and lead software engineer at Reaxe, a multi-tenant SaaS platform for home-remodeling contractors. Embedded systems on Badger Solar Racing. Looking for a Summer 2027 software engineering internship.

work.name: Reaxe LLC
work.summary: Multi-tenant SaaS platform (React, Node.js, Postgres) that home-remodeling contractors use to process $300K+ in contracts.
highlights: Reduced quote turnaround from two days to five minutes and improved quote accuracy by 58% for every contractor on the platform
Developed AI quoting and material-estimation pipelines on the Anthropic API, tuned by comparing quoted totals to final job costs
Isolated each contractor's records with Postgres row-level security and integrated Stripe, QuickBooks, Google Calendar, and Twilio

work.name: Wisconsin Tech Consulting
work.summary: Direct a six-analyst security and performance audit of PostBite, a consumer marketplace app built on Supabase, Vercel, and Stripe.
highlights: Closed a Supabase row-level security flaw that exposed every customer's order records to any authenticated user, reproducing it with a proof-of-concept query and driving a per-user RLS policy fix into production within a single release

Own the eight-week plan and founder-facing deliverables, including a 118-item requirements checklist mapped to Apple App Store Review Guidelines, WCAG 2.1 AA, and FTC endorsement rules, plus a 500-concurrent-user load test

work.name: Badger Solar Racing
highlights: Write embedded C firmware that handles CAN bus messages to keep turn-signal and safety-light state synchronized across all microcontroller nodes, falling back to a hazards-on safe default whenever CAN messages time out
Design lighting PCBs in Altium from manufacturer datasheets and verify signal integrity on each board with oscilloscope testing

projects.name: PickleIQ
highlights: Built and field-tested a coaching video-analysis platform with a commercial indoor pickleball facility, generating per-player biomechanical feedback for 200+ members
Fine-tuned TrackNetV2 on about 600 hand-labeled frames for a 68x gain in ball-detection coverage (0.5% to 34% of frames)
Shortened end-to-end rally segmentation time by 85% with a two-pass coarse-to-fine filter
Designed a local-and-cloud architecture with an isolated EC2 GPU worker, S3 exchange and a Lambda trigger per upload

projects.name: CNN Image Recognition for Emotion Classification
highlights: Trained CNNs in TensorFlow to classify facial expressions, using K-nearest neighbors as a comparison baseline
Boosted validation accuracy from 62% to 93% by preprocessing and augmenting the dataset and tuning hyperparameters

projects.name: Game Records Leaderboard
highlights: Created a command-line leaderboard that loads CSV files with automatic column detection and ranks the top 10 by score and time
Implemented storage as a Red-Black Tree with an in-order iterator for sorted range queries, verified with a full JUnit 5 test suite
